args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Created: May 15, 2024
Destination: Hawaii
Dates: June 10th - June 20th, 2024

Essential Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Emergency contact information

Clothing:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and sightseeing
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

Beach & Water Activities:
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Beach bag
- Waterproof watch

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Quick-dry t-shirts
- Rain jacket (for unexpected showers)
- Daypack/backpack
- Water bottle
- Insect repellent

Electronics:
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Phone charger
- Universal power adapter
- Portable power bank
- Headphones

Health & Personal Care:
- Prescription medications
- Basic first aid kit
- Motion sickness medication
- Hand sanitizer
- Toiletries
- Lip balm with SPF
- Hair ties/clips

Activities-Specific Items:
- Waikiki Beach (June 11): Beach toys, cooler for drinks
- Hanauma Bay Snorkeling (June 12): Underwater camera, rash guard
- Diamond Head Hiking (June 13): Trekking poles, trail map
- Pearl Harbor Visit (June 14): Respectful attire (covered shoulders/knees)
- North Shore Road Trip (June 15): Car snacks, playlist
- Polynesian Cultural Center Luau (June 16): Hawaiian shirt/dress
- Hotel Spa Day (June 17): Spa sandals, robe (if not provided)
- Kailua Beach Kayaking (June 18): Water shoes, dry bag
- Ala Moana Shopping (June 19): Reusable shopping bags

Miscellaneous:
- Travel pillow
- Books or e-reader
- Journal and pen
- Small backpack for daily excursions
- Laundry bag
- Ziplock bags for wet items
